_about: Pitch (working name; studied from 'Phantasic AI training video #1', see reels/study/t01/STUDY.md): a fast/slow talking-head pitch. One word at a time in two sizes (small calm words at chest height, big energy words; italic display serif for the dream-outcome words), electric-blue word pages and white highlight pages in bursts, a typed hook title box, #1 #2 #3 bubbles above the head, a faint serif word behind the head, black-and-white mood sentences. Hard cuts, no paper, no burns.

director.style: A fast/slow pitch. Long calm stretches carried by small one-word captions, broken by BURSTS of 4-6 visuals in 3-4 s at the hook, at each list point and at the payoff.
director.captions: captions.energy = [[from, to]] source-second spans drawn big: the hook question, the promise, each list point's opener, the payoff. Everything else stays calm and small. captions.serif = the 2-4 dream-outcome words (e.g. 'elite', 'expected improvement'); they switch to the italic serif.
director.pages: wordpage (accent field, one word at a time) for a short punchy sentence (4-8 words); highlight (white, a plain line + a box line that grows word by word) for the line that frames the list ('comes down / [to 3 things]'). 1.5-3 s each, on the spoken words.
director.titlebox: One per video, 0.2-0.4 s in: the topic in 2-5 words, typed in the accent box, held through the hook (to ~4-5 s).
director.behind: At most one: a faint serif word or number behind the head during the hook (font: serif), needs matte: true.
director.mood: Black and white for one pain/stakes sentence. At most one.
director.automatic: Bubbles on 'number one/two/three', logo tiles, punch-ins, music, sounds.
director.popcard: Pop cards: a famous public-domain painting (library/art, by concept) flips in over the speaker with the spoken word as its label, the camera defocusing behind it. Every 4-6 s in calm stretches, 1-1.6 s each, on a concrete noun or idea word.
director.cardpage: Card page: white page, a small painting swapping every 0.3-0.5 s, the spoken words under it. Once or twice per video, in a burst.
director.context: BEFORE choosing any picture, read the WHOLE transcript and write build/context.json: {topic, audience, domain, promise, glossary: {term: meaning IN THIS VIDEO}, entities: [tools, people, brands], tone}. Every visual is chosen from the glossary meaning, never the dictionary word: in an AI video 'tokens' = text split into model tokens (cost), 'agent' = software, 'model' = an LLM, 'training' = model training, 'frequency' = how often a task repeats.
director.visual_ladder: Pick the FIRST rung that fits the meaning: (1) a UI card that shows the literal thing (popcard ui: tokens | calendar | stopwatch | bars | loop | target); (2) the named tool's logo; (3) a real screenshot of the product/site; (4) a painting (library/art) ONLY for an emotion, a metaphor or a human situation (stress, vision, the grind, a team, a win). Never a painting for a literal tech or business term. If nothing fits, show nothing: a wrong picture is worse than none.
